verdict.rationale: Trivy is a CLI-first scanner explicitly designed for CI/automation: hands-on probes confirm headless execution with `--exit-code` for pipeline gating and JSON output (trivy-probe-6, trivy-probe-8), and community testimonials corroborate ease of CI/CD integration (trivy-comm-14, trivy-comm-11, trivy-comm-12). Installation via brew/docker further supports scripted, non-interactive use (trivy-gh-2). Missing for 10: deeper first-party documentation of specific CI platform templates (e.g. GitHub Actions/GitLab CI snippets) beyond generic CLI flags.
